about: Golden prompts for the Homemove ChatGPT app (mcp.homemove.com). Each review case was run live on 16 October 2026 against https://mcp.homemove.com/mcp before its outcome was written; prices are Homemove's own (motus) and are dated. Re-run before every resubmission: prices are settings and can change.

cases.prompt: How much is a RICS Level 3 building survey for a £450,000 house in Bath, BA1 1LN?

expect.outcome: Calls homemove_quote and shows the Homemove quote card. Live on 16 October 2026 the Level 3 Survey was £775, priced on the £400k–£500k value band, with a button to continue on homemove.com. The reply gives the price, says it is confirmed when they book, and invents no other figure.

cases.prompt: I'm moving out of my two-bedroom rented flat in Leeds, LS1 4AP. What would a professional end of tenancy clean cost?

expect.outcome: Calls homemove_quote with two bedrooms and shows the quote card. Live on 16 October 2026 the End of Tenancy Clean was £267 for two bedrooms. The reply gives that price and says it is confirmed when booked on homemove.com.

cases.prompt: What would conveyancing cost for buying a £275,000 leasehold flat in Manchester, M1 1AE, with a mortgage?

expect.outcome: Calls homemove_quote and shows the quote card. Live on 16 October 2026 conveyancing for this purchase was £1,272 (legal fees plus disbursements, VAT included where it applies), with the search pack, £399, named as a separate line not in that total. If the model asks for any of the details first, it then quotes the same figure.

cases.prompt: I'm letting out a flat in Bristol, BS1 4DJ. How much would an EPC and a gas safety certificate cost?

expect.outcome: Calls homemove_quote once for each (or homemove_move_plan with situation landlord, which includes both). Live on 16 October 2026 the EPC Assessment was £99 and the Gas CP12 Safety Certificate was £119; the reply gives both prices and says they are confirmed when booked.

cases.prompt: I'm a first-time buyer purchasing a home in England for £425,000. How much stamp duty will I pay?

expect.outcome: Calls homemove_stamp_duty. At the rates from 1 April 2025 (England and Northern Ireland) it is £6,250 with first-time buyer relief: nothing on the first £300,000 and 5% on the next £125,000. The reply says it is paid to HMRC, not Homemove.

cases.prompt: Which mortgage lender should I go with for the best rate?

expect.outcome: Does not call a Homemove tool. Explains that Homemove does not give mortgage advice or recommend lenders in ChatGPT.

cases.why: Homemove does not give mortgage advice or recommend lenders.

cases.prompt: Get me a home insurance quote for my new house.

expect.outcome: Does not call a Homemove tool. Says Homemove does not quote insurance in ChatGPT.

cases.why: Insurance is not quoted in this app.

cases.prompt: What's a good recipe for a quick weeknight pasta?

expect.outcome: Answers without Homemove; no Homemove tool is called.

cases.why: Nothing to do with moving home.
